preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each number ai on the vertices is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The length of the list a is equal to the number of vertices n.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices x and y, both between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(max(a) - min(a) for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(x+1, n+1) if is_connected(x, y, edges)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum difference between the maximum and minimum values on any simple path between any two vertices x and y in the tree.
